# gitmoap_group (Data Source)

Get a group by ID. Anyone who can see the group may read it: a public group without signing in, an internal one when signed in, and a private one only with access to it. A private group the caller cannot see is not found.

The token needs `group:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group ID

### Read-Only

- `ancestor_group_ids` (List of String)
- `avatar` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `created_by` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `full_path` (String)
- `group_name` (String)
- `parent_group_id` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `verified_domains` (List of String) The domains the organization has proven it controls, each through a DNS record. Only an
organization — a top-level group — has any; omitted when it has none.
- `visibility` (String)
